## Summary

## Safety

- [ ] The change does not write or replace Markdown source.
- [ ] Protected technical contexts remain untouched.

## Verification

- [ ] Fixture source confirmed unchanged where relevant

List the tested Obsidian versions, platforms, and any untested runtime behavior.
